_note: SYNTHETIC. A fictional CRM for a made-up company (Peridot). Every tool, field and enum here was invented for this example. It is deliberately imperfect: two clusters of near-synonym retrieval names (four on customer, three on invoice), raw enum codes with human labels beside them, one nested filter object, and a required list that does not match what is genuinely essential. Those flaws are what the factors have something to bite on.
_coverage_note: The last six tools (get_pipeline_stage onwards) are NOT exercised by examples/crm/suite.jsonl. That is on purpose and it mirrors reality: a real server exposes more tools than any one suite covers. catalogue.size can only be measured when some tools are droppable, so a catalogue whose every tool the suite expects makes that factor unmeasurable - which toolsweep reports rather than hides.
_format: MCP tools/list response, with toolsweep's x-toolsweep extension block carrying not_for text, essential flags and enum labels.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Retrieve one customer record by its Peridot customer id. Returns the full record including billing address and lifecycle status.

include_archived.description: Include customers that have been archived.

x-toolsweep.not_for: when you only have an email address or a company name; those have their own tools.

tools.name: lookup_customer
tools.description: Look up one customer record by email address. Returns the same record shape as the id lookup.

email.description: Exact email address on the customer record.

x-toolsweep.not_for: for partial or fuzzy email matching; this requires an exact address.

tools.name: find_customer
tools.description: Find customers whose company name matches the given text. Fuzzy, returns up to twenty ranked matches.

name.description: Company name or fragment of one to match against.

region.description: Restrict matches to one sales region.

x-toolsweep.not_for: when you already know the customer id or email.

tools.name: search_customer
tools.description: Search the customer book by structured filters rather than by text. Use for questions about groups of customers.

limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return.

x-toolsweep.not_for: for finding one specific customer you can already identify.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve one invoice by its invoice id, including line items and payment state.

x-toolsweep.not_for: when you have a customer rather than an invoice; list their invoices instead.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List every invoice belonging to one customer, most recent first.

customer_id.description: Peridot customer id whose invoices to list.

status.description: Restrict the list to one payment status.

limit.description: Maximum number of invoices to return.

x-toolsweep.not_for: when you already have the invoice id.

tools.name: find_invoice
tools.description: Find invoices by free-text reference, purchase order number or memo line.

query.description: Reference, purchase order number or memo text to match.

x-toolsweep.not_for: when you have an invoice id or a customer id.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a new draft invoice for a customer. The invoice is not sent until it is issued.

amount_cents.description: Total invoice amount in minor currency units.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the invoice.

memo.description: Free-text memo shown on the invoice.

x-toolsweep.not_for: to change an invoice that already exists.

tools.name: update_invoice
tools.description: Change the amount, currency or memo of an invoice that is still in draft.

amount_cents.description: Replacement total in minor currency units.

x-toolsweep.not_for: on an invoice that has already been sent; void it and raise a new one.

tools.name: void_invoice
tools.description: Void an issued invoice so it can no longer be paid. Irreversible.

reason.description: Why the invoice is being voided.

x-toolsweep.not_for: to correct a draft invoice; update it instead.

tools.name: send_invoice_reminder
tools.description: Email a payment reminder to the billing contact on an overdue invoice.

tone.description: How firm the reminder should read.

x-toolsweep.not_for: to send the invoice itself for the first time.

tools.name: add_customer_note
tools.description: Attach a free-text note to a customer's timeline. Notes are visible to the whole account team.

pinned.description: Pin the note to the top of the timeline.

x-toolsweep.not_for: to record a task somebody has to do; create a task instead.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task on a customer, assigned to a named owner with a due date.

owner_email.description: Who the task is assigned to.

x-toolsweep.not_for: to record something that already happened; add a note instead.

tools.name: close_task
tools.description: Mark an open follow-up task as done.

x-toolsweep.not_for: to delete a task; closing keeps it on the timeline.

tools.name: get_pipeline_stage
tools.description: Retrieve the current sales pipeline stage for one opportunity.

tools.name: advance_pipeline_stage
tools.description: Move an opportunity to the next stage of the sales pipeline.

stage.description: Stage to move the opportunity into.

tools.name: export_customer_csv
tools.description: Export a customer's record and invoice history as a CSV file.

include_invoices.description: Include invoice history in the export.

tools.name: merge_customers
tools.description: Merge a duplicate customer record into a surviving one. Irreversible.

x-toolsweep.not_for: to archive a customer that is simply inactive.

tools.name: set_credit_limit
tools.description: Set the credit limit on a customer account, in minor currency units.

limit_cents.description: New credit limit in minor currency units.

tools.name: schedule_review_meeting
tools.description: Book a quarterly account review meeting with a customer's contacts.
